text:
Type: flatwoven diamond area rug
Use: defining a seating or reading area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: flatwoven fibers, low flat weave
Colors: slate blue, light grey, mustard gold accents
Shape: rectangular, central field of small intersecting diamonds fading into speckled grey edges, flat and thin, medium size
Feel: textured, relaxed, lively
Goes with: light wood floors, white or teal walls, brass accents; modern or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Flatwoven Rug with Intersecting Diamonds, 4' x 6', Blue and Gray with Gold
product.description: This contemporary rug will add texture, depth, and color wherever you have a bare floor or need to create visual interest in a room. Its classic coloring ensures that it will pair with many color schemes. Flatwoven wool and cotton mean this soft rug will bring warmth to any room. 4'W x 6'L 77% wool, 16% cotton, 7% Lurex Transitional design in colors that can be paired with any decor Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with a rug pad (sold separately)
